_comment: Cards that exist only for tests/unit/casting/test_granted_alternative_cost.py. Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_energy_grant` is Nissa, Worldsoul Speaker's static at a smaller price (three energy) and with no landfall, so a test sets the energy it needs; `t_life_grant` is the same grant paid in life, the other currency the static accepts.

cards.name: Test Energy Grant
cards.oracle_text: You may pay three {E} rather than pay the mana cost for permanent spells you cast.

abilities.text: You may pay three {E} rather than pay the mana cost for permanent spells you cast.

cards.name: Test Life Grant
cards.oracle_text: You may pay 5 life rather than pay the mana cost for creature spells you cast.

abilities.text: You may pay 5 life rather than pay the mana cost for creature spells you cast.
